what: International Flavors and Fragrances creates the tastes and smells in consumer products: flavours for food and drink, fragrances for perfume and detergent, enzymes and cultures for food production, and health ingredients.
customers: Food and beverage manufacturers, perfume and household product companies, and pharmaceutical and nutrition businesses.
moat: Formulas written into customers' products, where changing the flavour or scent changes the product itself, so reformulation is a last resort.
risks: It reported a loss after writing down goodwill from the DuPont nutrition acquisition
Revenue has fallen about 4% a year over three years
Debt of about $6.7 billion against almost no cash
Return on invested capital is negative after the write-downs
opportunities: Analysts see about 23% upside from current levels
Selling Pharma Solutions raises cash to cut debt
Health and Biosciences earns the best margins and grows faster than the rest
watch: Organic volume growth and the pace of debt reduction.
